name: Fate's Chosen

facts.text: Level 81, 40,000 health. No scripted mechanic beyond its reset. Caer Sidi also holds 'fate's bearers' and the Horsemen's Harbingers of Fate.

story:
The four riders at the top of Caer Sidi serve fate, and fate keeps servants of its own lower down. Fate's Chosen is the one the riders sent below to keep the fate's bearers in order and to see who climbs. It is not cunning and it is not cruel. It simply stands where it was told to stand, as it has since before the gaol rose, and the riders know the name of everyone who passes it. Some say it was a prisoner once, chosen by the riders to serve; it has never said.

The riders' servant. The four riders at the top of Caer Sidi serve fate, and fate keeps servants of its own lower down. The fate's bearers who walk the fortress carry the riders' business, and Fate's Chosen keeps them in order: a prisoner, some say, that the riders themselves chose out of the common dead and set at a post halfway up the gaol, to watch who climbs. It has never said. It has never needed to.

Its post. It is not cunning and it is not cruel. It stands where it was told to stand, as it has since before the gaol rose, and every raid that passes it is reported upward: the riders know the name of everyone who comes, and Fames knows which face he will choose before the raid reaches his hall. Albion's raid leaders treat Fate's Chosen as the riders' test. A raid that cannot kill it cleanly is not ready for the four, and the riders, who are courteous, would prefer not to waste their question on it.
legend: A straight fight with no tricks: tank it, heal through it and burn it down. Its value is as a test. If your raid cannot kill Fate's Chosen clean, with no deaths and no panic, it is not ready to climb to the riders. Save the big cooldowns for the four; this one should fall to steady work. Use the fight to check your raid: who is late to heal, who stands in the wrong place, who wanders. Fix it here, because the riders are not forgiving, and Fames will choose one of you to answer for everyone. The riders are watching, after all.

aggro: The riders will know your names.
Halfway is far enough for most.

loremasterTopic.text: The riders' servant below, set to keep the fate's bearers in order and see who climbs. If your raid cannot pass it cleanly, do not climb further.

bookPage: Halfway up the fortress a single figure stood at a post, and the fate's bearers who passed it bowed to it as servants bow to a steward. Dame Ysolde called it the riders' test, and said that if we could not kill it cleanly we would turn back, and meant it. We killed it cleanly. As it fell it said that the riders would be told, and I felt, as I have felt nowhere else in my life, that someone far above us had just learned my name. When Fames looked along our ranks an hour later, I was not surprised that he knew whom to choose.
